builtInDescriptions.bash: Run a controlled Git Bash command from the active Workspace. The cwd is an initial working directory, not a filesystem sandbox.

availabilityReasons.available: Available in the current Runtime generation.
availabilityReasons.notReported: Runtime did not report this tool.

bash.title: Git Bash configuration
bash.runningDescription: These controls save desired configuration only. A manual override takes precedence and is validated exactly; Auto Detect applies only when no manual path is configured. Runtime validates the selected executable when the next generation starts.
bash.stoppedDescription: Desired configuration is saved for the next Runtime generation. A manual override takes precedence and is validated exactly; Auto Detect applies only when no manual path is configured. Current readiness is unavailable until Runtime reports it.
bash.noSandboxWarning: Bash is not an OS filesystem sandbox.
bash.boundary: Bash uses the active Workspace as its initial working directory. It can still access files outside that directory and the network; Policy, Approval, hard limits, and process ownership are the controls.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Edit the next Runtime generation's desired policy and observe the current generation's effective decisions. Runtime compilation remains authoritative.
policies.restartRequiredDescription: Desired policy is saved, but the current Runtime generation is still using its previous snapshot.
policies.toolDefaultsDescription: A default is used only when no enabled User Rule matches. Bash defaults to ASK and remains subject to Runtime analyzer risk floors.
policies.userRulesDescription: Rules are persisted as typed matchers. Bash Command prefixes match exact normalized tokens; they are not regular expressions or substrings.
policies.userRulesHelp: Dynamic or unclassified Bash expressions stay at least ASK. A Tool-level Bash ALLOW is not a filesystem sandbox and does not bypass Runtime approval or risk floors.
policies.approvalBashCommandDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. This Bash Command matcher is a reviewable exact-token draft; creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.approvalBashToolDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. This starts from a Bash Tool ASK draft; review it before saving because creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.approvalToolDraft: Current approval scope: {{scope}}. The persistent M3 tool rule below is broader than this exact scope; review it before saving because creating a rule never resolves the current approval.
policies.name: Name
policies.bashArgvPrefixHelp: Exact normalized token prefix; this is not a regex or substring. Use [] for any argv after the executable.
policies.effectiveDescription: These rows come from Runtime's compiled snapshot. System Guardrails are always read-only.
policies.effectiveUnavailable: Runtime effective policy is unavailable until a generation is running.
policies.invalidSnapshotDescription: Policy-controlled tools are denied until a valid snapshot is compiled by the next Runtime generation.
policies.noCompiledUserRules: No User Rules compiled in this generation.
policies.approvalDraftPrepared: Approval scope prepared as a policy draft. Review and save it explicitly.

m8Approvals.pendingDescription: Review the Runtime facts that matter before choosing a decision.
m8Approvals.refreshHint: Refresh the Approval Center and try again.
m8Approvals.stale: Approval data is stale. Existing evidence is retained, but decisions are paused until Runtime confirms the current state.
m8Approvals.runtimeChanged: The Runtime identity changed. Previous requests are stale until the current approval queue is read.
m8Approvals.sessionChanged: The managed Harness session changed. Previous requests are stale until Runtime confirms them again.
m8Approvals.noPending: No pending approvals were reported by the current Runtime snapshot.
m8Approvals.historyEmpty: No terminal approvals are in the current snapshot.
m8Approvals.unavailable: Approval state is unavailable. Existing content is retained when possible; refresh when Runtime is available.
m8Approvals.riskNotReported: Runtime did not report additional risk flags; treat the sanitized preview as limited evidence.
m8Approvals.riskUnclassified: Runtime could not classify this command. Treat it as high risk and inspect the complete evidence before deciding.
m8Approvals.riskFlagImpact: {{flag}} can change command meaning or execution scope; review the sanitized evidence before deciding.
m8Approvals.previewUnconfirmed: Runtime did not report a complete preview. Only the sanitized target and arguments are shown; hidden content is not inferred.
m8Approvals.previewIncomplete: This preview is {{state}}. Secrets and omitted command text are not reconstructed here.
m8Approvals.previewComplete: Runtime reported a complete sanitized preview.
m8Approvals.activeWorkspace: Current Runtime workspace (active_workspace). The physical path is intentionally not inferred here.
m8Approvals.expiresSoon: This request is close to expiry. Runtime must still confirm the final state.
m8Approvals.expiredCheck: This request may have expired. Checking Runtime state…
m8Approvals.sessionScope: Allow for session reuses the same tool and Runtime-approved scope only within this Runtime session; it expires when the session restarts.
m8Approvals.fileSessionScope: Allow for session reuses the {{tool}} tool within the Runtime-approved logical scope {{scope}} for this Runtime session. Different file contents may still be included; restarting the session invalidates the grant.
m8Approvals.sessionUnavailable: Allow for session is disabled for unclassified high-risk commands or unavailable because Runtime did not report an eligible reusable scope: {{reason}}
m8Approvals.decisionSubmitted: Decision submitted to Runtime. This does not claim that the tool execution succeeded.
m8Approvals.decisionFailed: The decision was not confirmed. Runtime state was refreshed; review this request before trying again.
m8Approvals.alreadyResolved: This request is already resolved, expired, or cancelled.
m8Approvals.runtimeUnavailable: Runtime identity could not be confirmed, so this request cannot be decided.
m8Approvals.requestStale: This request belongs to a different Runtime identity and cannot be decided.
m8Approvals.noSegments: No displayable normalized segments were reported.
m8Approvals.argvRedacted: argv redacted; this segment cannot safely prefill a command matcher.
m8Approvals.displayFacts: Display facts: {{state}}. They remain evidence only and cannot be used to reconstruct hidden command text.
m8Approvals.wholeToolScope: This draft covers the whole {{tool}} tool because the request only exposes a logical path scope; it is broader than this path.
m8Approvals.ruleDraftPrepared: A rule draft is ready for review. Creating it does not resolve this approval or grant a session allowance.
m8Approvals.unsafeRuleDraft: The command evidence is incomplete or ambiguous, so no Bash command matcher was prefilled. Choose the scope explicitly in Policies.
m8Approvals.staleDecision: Decision controls are paused while Runtime state is stale.
m8Approvals.noExecutionClaim: A submitted approval records a decision only; execution outcome is reported separately by Activity.
m8Approvals.expiryUnconfirmed: Runtime did not report a valid expiry time, so this request cannot be decided.

m8Activity.scope: Filters apply only to the currently loaded bounded snapshot (up to 100 records).
m8Activity.staleHelp: The last readable snapshot is retained as historical evidence. Current state is not confirmed.
m8Activity.empty: No retained activity in this snapshot
m8Activity.emptyHelp: An empty bounded snapshot does not establish readiness or mean no requests have ever occurred.
m8Activity.noMatches: No records match this filter in the loaded snapshot.
m8Activity.historicalRule: This event reports matched rule IDs only. A current rule, when available, is separate configuration and is not a reconstruction of the historical rule.
m8Activity.historicalApproval: This event is historical evidence. The current approval record may be unavailable or may have changed.
m8Activity.noCurrentRule: The matched rule is not available in the current policy snapshot.
m8Activity.noCurrentApproval: The approval is not available in the current approval snapshot.

nextStep.success: No remediation is indicated by this evidence.
nextStep.policy_denied: Review the current policy evidence before changing configuration.
nextStep.approval_denied: The user denied this approval. Request approval again only if the operation is still needed.
nextStep.execution_failed: Inspect the reported failure evidence before retrying.
nextStep.unavailable: Check the current Runtime and tool availability, then refresh this snapshot.
nextStep.pending: Wait for the reported approval or execution event; this snapshot does not complete it.
nextStep.cancelled: The reported operation was cancelled. Start a new request if it is still needed.
nextStep.expired: The reported approval expired. Start a new request if it is still needed.
nextStep.denied: Review the reported denial evidence before deciding what to do next.
nextStep.in_progress: Refresh after the operation reports a terminal outcome.
